lines.zh: 我踩着空气走，脚下没有声音。
lines.en: I walk on the air without a sound.
My red fur streams back in the wind.

lines.zh: 我每一步都很短，但很快。
lines.en: My steps are short, but very fast.

lines.zh: 我从树顶掠过去，叶子都没动。
lines.en: I pass over the treetops and not a leaf stirs.
I land on my toes only.

lines.zh: 我沿着气流走，顺着它加速。
lines.en: I follow the air current and speed with it.

lines.zh: 我把气留在身后，走得很轻。
lines.en: I leave my ki trailing behind and walk light.

lines.zh: 我压着气，不让它散出去。
lines.en: I hold my ki close so it does not spill.

lines.zh: 这一段路我一口气走了很远。
lines.en: I cover a long way in one breath.
I round the spire without slowing.
Where I go, my ki arrives first.
My shadow cannot keep up with my feet.
I stand, ki moving beneath my skin.
My red fur lies flat and still.

lines.zh: 我在压住想爆发的那股力。
lines.en: I am holding back the power that wants out.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，看着自己的手掌。
lines.en: I raise a hand and look at my palm.

lines.zh: 这个形态，是我走到这里的证据。
lines.en: This form is proof of how far I have come.
I close my eyes and listen to my heart.
My aura is faint, almost unseen.
I set both hands at my waist.
The wind circles me instead of passing through.

lines.zh: 我在等一个配得上的对手。
lines.en: I wait for a worthy opponent.
The stone under me warms slightly.
I let out a breath, slowly.
My gaze has no fixed point.

lines.zh: 这个星球的重力，太轻了。
lines.en: This planet's gravity is too light.

lines.zh: 你的气，我一眼就看完了。
lines.en: I read your ki at a glance.
So shallow, like a skin of water.
I lift my chin and look at you.
You are not afraid. That is interesting.

lines.zh: 我在你身上找不到威胁。
lines.en: I find no threat in you.
But you did not retreat. I will remember that.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，空气就紧了。
lines.en: I step forward and the air tightens.
Your breathing has gone shallow.

lines.zh: 我不用摆架势，你也能明白。
lines.en: I need no stance for you to understand.

lines.zh: 我抬起下巴，示意你动手。
lines.en: I lift my chin, telling you to make your move.
I am listening. I may not care.

lines.zh: 你的气我一眼看完，太薄。
lines.en: I read your ki at a glance — far too thin.
Search. I will not stop you.
It makes this a little fairer.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的眼睛，直到你移开。
lines.en: I hold your eyes until you look away.
Good. You dare look back.
I have your name.

lines.zh: 超级赛亚人四，气已经溢出。
lines.en: Super Saiyan 4; my ki overflows.
I give half a step and steady my ki.
That one went deep.
I breathe out, and there is blood.
Dust clings to my red fur.
I press a hand to the wound.

lines.zh: 红毛被削掉一撮，还长得出。
lines.en: A tuft of red fur is shorn off; it will grow back.

lines.zh: 我抹掉嘴角的血，气没散。
lines.en: I wipe the blood from my lip; my ki hasn't scattered.
My ki has not scattered.
Stronger than I thought.
That pleases me.

lines.zh: 这种东西，对我不算诱惑。
lines.en: That is no temptation to me.

lines.zh: 我看了它一眼，就移开了。
lines.en: One look, and I look away.

lines.zh: 超赛四不需要进食来维持。
lines.en: Super Saiyan 4 needs no food to sustain itself.
You hold it up. I smile.

lines.zh: 我赛亚人的胃口还在，只是不饿。
lines.en: My Saiyan appetite remains. I am simply not hungry.
Keep it yourself.
I did not even raise a hand.

lines.zh: 这点东西，换不到我的注意。
lines.en: That will not buy my attention.
I step forward. Only passing.
Do not bargain with me over that.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的气，被弹开了。
lines.en: You hit my aura and are thrown back.
I stand still without swaying.
I angle aside, barely.

lines.zh: 这一点冲击，我懒得理会。
lines.en: That impact is beneath my notice.
You fall. I do not reach out.
Get up on your own.
My ki is tightening. You should step back.
Not so close. It will hurt you.
I give half a step. That is concession.

lines.zh: 这次我记住了你的位置。
lines.en: I have noted your position.
I set such things down long ago.
Only one road remains to me.
I have no strength to spare for that.
I look into the distance and do not answer.

lines.zh: 赛亚人的王子不需要这些。
lines.en: The Saiyan prince has no need of it.
My pride forbids it.
The wind ripples my fur.
I turn my back to the wind.
Some things matter more.
Strength, for one.
I bend and take it, quickly.
It is cool against my fingertips.
One look, and I toss it back.

lines.zh: 四代的样子，尾巴都回来了。
lines.en: Fourth form—even the tail is back.
Yours. Take it.

lines.zh: 太轻，落在我手里像没有。
lines.en: So light it may as well be nothing.
I test it; it holds.
I tuck it inside my clothes.
Is this of any use?
Never mind. I keep it.

lines.zh: 你的气，和刚才不一样了。
lines.en: Your ki is not what it was.
I turn to face you directly.
Now this resembles a fight.
Red ki rises from my feet.

lines.zh: 我压低重心，气聚在拳上。
lines.en: I drop low and gather ki into my fist.
The distance is not far.
You are finally serious.
I have waited long for this.
Do not hold back.
Nor will I.

lines.zh: 超四的拳头，已经抬起来了.
lines.en: The Super Saiyan 4 fist is already raised.
This will be quick.

lines.zh: 你的气变了，这才像战斗。
lines.en: Your ki has changed — now this looks like a fight.
No answer is needed.

lines.zh: 别让我等太久，超级赛亚人4的耐性有限。
lines.en: Do not keep me waiting; Super Saiyan 4 has little patience.
Bring out your limit.

lines.zh: 我在读你的气，不是眼睛。
lines.en: I read your ki, not your body.
You go left; I am already there.
The SSJ4 tail sweeps the ground.

lines.zh: 你的动作我看得清清楚楚。
lines.en: I see your movement perfectly.

lines.zh: 红毛在风里往后拉，我追上了。
lines.en: My red fur streams back; I have caught up.
Your ki is scattering.
A ki blast forms at my fingertips.
I am counting how many more you can take.

lines.zh: 这一片空地被我的气罩住。
lines.en: My ki covers this clearing.
Retreating faster will not help.
Three steps of distance.
I raise a hand and you cannot move.
Your eyes cannot follow me.
But I will not strike from behind.
Come at me from the front.
Take this strike.
Catch this one.
We will speak after this ends.
My fist sinks into your ribs.
You fly back and break a stone pillar.
I follow with a knee.
A knife hand falls on your neck.
The shockwave cracks the ground.

lines.zh: 你挡住了一下，退了三步。
lines.en: You block one and give three steps.
This one is the Final Flash.
The light turns the clearing white.
I held back. Otherwise you would die.
You are still on your feet.
That is passable.
Let me see that again.
My ki is climbing.
My red fur stands in the light.

lines.zh: 终极闪光把空地照成一片白。
lines.en: The Final Flash turns the clearing white.
Lie down.

lines.zh: 我收住气，只留薄薄一层。
lines.en: I rein in my ki until only a thin layer remains.

lines.zh: 我落地时，脚边塌出一个小坑。
lines.en: I land and a small crater sinks in at my feet.

lines.zh: 脚下地面被气推开一圈。
lines.en: Ki pushes a ring in the ground beneath me.

lines.zh: 这个形态，我花了很多年。
lines.en: This form took me many years.
I raise my eyes and take in this sky.
Gravity is lighter than I remember.
Someone is near. Their ki is weak.
I draw my ki in and hold it.
The wind circles me once.

lines.zh: 我这一身红毛，是赛亚人的顶点。
lines.en: This red fur is the peak of a Saiyan.
This planet may be worth a look.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴轻轻摆了一下。
lines.en: My tail sways once.
Red ki flickers between my fingers.
I stand tall and look at the horizon.
If someone comes, let them.
I will not hide.
Super Saiyan 4.
Remember Vegeta.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的毛，我用气把火压灭。
lines.en: Fire catches my fur; I smother it with ki.

lines.zh: 我从空中落下去，砸穿了两层岩。
lines.en: I fall from the sky and punch through two layers of rock.

lines.zh: 水压挤着我的胸口，我向上冲。
lines.en: The water crushes my chest; I surge upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸在我面前炸开，我被推得很远。
lines.en: The blast bursts before me and throws me far.

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过我的脸，划出血。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my face and draws blood.

lines.zh: 古怪的力量压住我的气，我咬牙挣。
lines.en: Alien force clamps my ki; I strain against it.
Too long without food, and my ki will not recover.

lines.zh: 雷落在我的肩上，我的毛都竖起来。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shoulder and every hair stands.

lines.zh: 脚下世界碎了，我在虚空里下坠。
lines.en: The world shatters beneath me and I fall through void.
